vuln.name: Flask Debug Mode Enabled
vuln.description: The Flask application is running with debug mode (app.run(debug=True) or FLASK_DEBUG=1) enabled in production. The Werkzeug debugger exposes an interactive Python console at the traceback page.
vuln.impact: The Werkzeug debugger console allows arbitrary Python execution on the server by anyone who can trigger an exception (or via a PIN that is often brute-forceable). This is full remote code execution.
vuln.recommendation: Never run Flask with debug=True in production. Set FLASK_DEBUG=0 and use a production WSGI server (gunicorn/uwsgi). The debugger must never be reachable from untrusted clients.
